integrity: Eight standalone complete files supplied, with exact decoded byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes in the accompanying record; the proof and exact verifier are included.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected unweighted square rook graphs only; endpoint transition matrix, not RK internal stages; no classification for unequal Cartesian factors or other methods. General statement follows from projector identities and polynomial sign proof; finite exact checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. Historical novelty remains subject to independent literature review.
title: A reentrant positivity window for two-stage Radau IIA diffusion on square rook graphs
